definitions.explanation: A person selected to represent a team or participate in a competition, especially in sports.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{野球|やきゅう}{選手|せんしゅ}だ。
オリンピック{選手|せんしゅ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become an Olympic athlete.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}{生活|せいかつ}を{引退|いんたい}した。
examples.english: I retired from my athletic career.
examples.notes: 選手生活 = career as an athlete

notes:
USAGE: {選手|せんしゅ} refers to athletes or players who compete in sports or games. The word contains 選 (select) because these are people chosen to represent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{野球|やきゅう}/{サッカー}/{テニス}{選手|せんしゅ} (baseball/soccer/tennis player)
・{代表|だいひょう}{選手|せんしゅ} (representative player)
・プロ{選手|せんしゅ} (professional athlete)
・{選手|せんしゅ}{権|けん} (championship)
・{選手|せんしゅ}{生命|せいめい} (athletic career)

CONTRAST:
・{選手|せんしゅ} - athlete, player (competitive)
・プレイヤー - player (general, including non-competitive)
・{競技者|きょうぎしゃ} - competitor (formal)
